notes: Jam: listen together with friends, and Listen along straight from your Discord status. The Now Playing panel now shows the artist (photo, monthly listeners, bio), live lyrics, the song's credits, upcoming concerts, what's next in the queue, and Spotify's looping Canvas videos. Romanized lyrics (romaji for Japanese, Korean, pinyin and more), lyrics found more reliably, a new account menu with your Spotify and Discord accounts, and profile pages. SpotiLarp also spaces out what it asks Spotify and stays logged in if Spotify asks it to wait, instead of getting locked out.
